Aircraft shall be able: - to reach the Area of Interest (surveillance area) located at a distance of minimum 100NM from the Base Airport, and; - to stay minimum 1 hour in the Area of Interest with the average speed as of 90 knots, between 1000 feet and 5000 feet and return back to the base airport, and; - to perform a total minimum of 4 hours of flight (excluding final reserve and contingency fuel) with 1 Frontex liaison officer on board in line with the 2 requirements above with the minimum mandatory Payload stipulated in the Tender Dossier.
